files.text:
' KO ALLEY - a one on one street fighting game for the ZX Spectrum Next, in NTC BASIC (VB5 flavour)
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' Two brawlers, best of three rounds, 99 seconds a round. Punch, kick, a low sweep, a jump kick,
' blocking (hold away from the other fighter), and an energy orb you can throw.
'
' Straight to the Next's hardware: each fighter is six hardware sprites (Spr.cls) shown twice
' the size (64 x 96), mirrored to face left; the alley, the health bars and the text are the
' tilemap (Tiles.cls); the sound the AY (Sfx.cls). The art is in gfx/ - swap it with gfxtool.js.
'
' Player 1: Q A O P (jump, crouch, left, right), Space punch, M kick, N orb; or Kempston 1
'           (fire punch, fire 2 kick, fire while crouching throws the orb).
' Player 2: 7 6 5 8 (jump, crouch, left, right), 0 punch, 9 kick, 4 orb; or Kempston 2.
' One player: the computer is player 2.
Option Explicit
Option Turbo

Const FLOOR = 224
Const XMIN = 36, XMAX = 284
' states
Const S_IDLE = 0, S_WALK = 1, S_CROUCH = 2, S_JUMP = 3, S_ATTACK = 4, S_BLOCK = 5, S_HIT = 6, S_DOWN = 7, S_WIN = 8
' attacks
Const A_PUNCH = 1, A_KICK = 2, A_LOW = 3, A_JKICK = 4, A_ORB = 5
' how an attack must be blocked
Const Z_MID = 0, Z_HIGH = 1, Z_LOW = 2, Z_OVER = 3

Dim fx(1) As Integer, fy(1) As Integer, fvx(1) As Integer, fvy(1) As Integer, face(1) As Integer
Dim fs(1) As Integer, ft(1) As Integer, fatk(1) As Integer, fhit(1) As Integer, hp(1) As Integer
Dim wins(1) As Integer, flash(1) As Integer, anim(1) As Integer, push(1) As Integer
' the buttons each fighter holds this frame (the keyboard, a joystick or the computer)
Dim bL(1) As Integer, bR(1) As Integer, bU(1) As Integer, bD(1) As Integer
Dim bP(1) As Integer, bK(1) As Integer, bS(1) As Integer
Dim wasP(1) As Integer, wasK(1) As Integer, wasS(1) As Integer
' the orbs
Dim ox(1) As Integer, oy(1) As Integer, ovx(1) As Integer, oon(1) As Integer
' the computer
Dim aiT As Integer, aiPlan As Integer, aiHold As Integer
Dim players As Integer, rnum As Integer, clock As Integer, tick As Integer, over As Integer, roundOver As Integer
Dim sparkT As Integer, sparkX As Integer, sparkY As Integer
Dim frames As Integer, seed As Integer, firewas As Integer
Dim i As Integer

Nx.Border 0
Tiles.Init
Spr.Init
GfxData.Load
Sfx.Init
Nx.Layers Nx.OrderSLU
Do
  Title
  Match
Loop

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- input
Sub ReadPads()
  Dim j As Integer
  j = Keys.Joystick(0)
  bL(0) = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyO) Or ((j And Keys.JoyLeft) <> 0)
  bR(0) = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyP) Or ((j And Keys.JoyRight) <> 0)
  bU(0) = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyQ) Or ((j And Keys.JoyUp) <> 0)
  bD(0) = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyA) Or ((j And Keys.JoyDown) <> 0)
  bP(0) = Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or (((j And Keys.JoyFire1) <> 0) And Not bD(0))
  bK(0) = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyM) Or ((j And Keys.JoyFire2) <> 0)
  bS(0) = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyN) Or (((j And Keys.JoyFire1) <> 0) And bD(0))
  If players = 2 Then
    j = Keys.Joystick(1)
    bL(1) = Keys.Down(Keys.Key5) Or ((j And Keys.JoyLeft) <> 0)
    bR(1) = Keys.Down(Keys.Key8) Or ((j And Keys.JoyRight) <> 0)
    bU(1) = Keys.Down(Keys.Key7) Or ((j And Keys.JoyUp) <> 0)
    bD(1) = Keys.Down(Keys.Key6) Or ((j And Keys.JoyDown) <> 0)
    bP(1) = Keys.Down(Keys.Key0) Or (((j And Keys.JoyFire1) <> 0) And Not bD(1))
    bK(1) = Keys.Down(Keys.Key9) Or ((j And Keys.JoyFire2) <> 0)
    bS(1) = Keys.Down(Keys.Key4) Or (((j And Keys.JoyFire1) <> 0) And bD(1))
  Else
    Computer
  End If
End Sub

Function FirePressed() As Integer
  Dim f As Integer
  f = Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyEnter) Or ((Keys.Joystick(0) And Keys.JoyFire1) <> 0)
  FirePressed = f And Not firewas
  firewas = f
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the computer (player 2)
Sub Computer()
  Dim d As Integer, r As Integer, fwdR As Integer
  bL(1) = 0 : bR(1) = 0 : bU(1) = 0 : bD(1) = 0 : bP(1) = 0 : bK(1) = 0 : bS(1) = 0
  If roundOver Then Exit Sub
  d = Abs(fx(1) - fx(0))
  fwdR = (fx(0) > fx(1))           ' the player is to the right
  ' a block when the player attacks close by (or an orb comes)
  If (fs(0) = S_ATTACK And d < 90) Or (oon(0) And Abs(ox(0) - fx(1)) < 70) Then
    If Rnd(100) < 40 + rnum * 10 Then
      aiPlan = 6 : aiT = 12
    End If
  End If
  If aiT <= 0 Then
    r = Rnd(100)
    If d > 150 Then
      If r < 18 And oon(1) = 0 Then aiPlan = 5 Else aiPlan = 1
      aiT = 10 + Rnd(10)
    ElseIf d > 70 Then
      If r < 55 Then
        aiPlan = 1
      ElseIf r < 67 Then
        aiPlan = 7
      ElseIf r < 77 And oon(1) = 0 Then
        aiPlan = 5
      Else
        aiPlan = 0
      End If
      aiT = 8 + Rnd(12)
    Else
      If r < 30 Then
        aiPlan = 2
      ElseIf r < 52 Then
        aiPlan = 3
      ElseIf r < 70 Then
        aiPlan = 4
      ElseIf r < 82 Then
        aiPlan = 8
      ElseIf r < 90 Then
        aiPlan = 7
      Else
        aiPlan = 0
      End If
      aiT = 10 + Rnd(10)
    End If
  End If
  aiT = aiT - 1
  Select Case aiPlan
    Case 1          ' walk in
      If fwdR Then bR(1) = -1 Else bL(1) = -1
    Case 2          ' punch
      bP(1) = (aiT And 7) = 0
    Case 3          ' kick
      bK(1) = (aiT And 7) = 0
    Case 4          ' sweep
      bD(1) = -1
      bK(1) = (aiT And 7) = 0
    Case 5          ' an orb
      bS(1) = -1
    Case 6          ' block: hold away
      If fwdR Then bL(1) = -1 Else bR(1) = -1
    Case 7          ' jump in
      bU(1) = -1
      If fwdR Then bR(1) = -1 Else bL(1) = -1
      If fy(1) < FLOOR - 30 Then bK(1) = -1
    Case 8          ' back off
      If fwdR Then bL(1) = -1 Else bR(1) = -1
  End Select
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the screen
Sub Alley()
  Dim x As Integer, y As Integer, h As Integer, t As Integer
  Tiles.Fill GfxData.T_SKY
  For x = 0 To 39
    If Rnd(3) = 0 Then Tiles.Put x, 4 + Rnd(4), GfxData.T_STARS
  Next
  ' buildings: blocks of height 3-7 rows over the wall
  x = 0
  Do While x < 40
    h = 3 + Rnd(5)
    For y = 12 - h To 11
      For t = x To x + 4
        If t < 40 Then
          If Rnd(3) = 0 Then Tiles.Put t, y, GfxData.T_WIN1 + Rnd(2) Else Tiles.Put t, y, GfxData.T_BUILD
        End If
      Next
    Next
    x = x + 5
  Loop
  ' the brick wall, the doorway, the sign, the pavement
  For y = 12 To 25
    For x = 0 To 39
      Tiles.Put x, y, GfxData.T_BRICK - ((x + y) Mod 7 = 0)
    Next
  Next
  Tiles.Rect 30, 17, 4, 9, GfxData.T_DOOR
  Tiles.Rect 6, 14, 10, 4, GfxData.T_SIGN + 4
  Tiles.Rect 6, 14, 10, 1, GfxData.T_SIGN
  Tiles.Rect 6, 17, 10, 1, GfxData.T_SIGN + 1
  Tiles.Rect 6, 15, 1, 2, GfxData.T_SIGN + 2
  Tiles.Rect 15, 15, 1, 2, GfxData.T_SIGN + 3
  Tiles.Text 8, 15, "BLUE"
  Tiles.Text 9, 16, "LAMP"
  Tiles.Rect 0, 26, 40, 2, GfxData.T_WALLB
  For y = 28 To 31
    For x = 0 To 39
      Tiles.Put x, y, GfxData.T_PAVE + Rnd(2)
    Next
  Next
  Tiles.Rect 0, 0, 40, 4, GfxData.T_DARK
End Sub

Sub HudNames()
  Tiles.Text 2, 0, "JAX"
  If players = 2 Then Tiles.Text 31, 0, "KANE 2P" Else Tiles.Text 31, 0, "KANE CPU"
  Hud
End Sub

Sub Hud()
  Dim k As Integer, n As Integer, t As Integer
  ' player 1's bar: cells 2-17, full from the left; player 2's: cells 22-37, full from the right
  n = (hp(0) * 128) \ 100
  For k = 0 To 15
    t = n - k * 8
    If t > 8 Then t = 8
    If t < 0 Then t = 0
    Tiles.Put 2 + k, 1, GfxData.T_BAR + t
  Next
  n = (hp(1) * 128) \ 100
  For k = 0 To 15
    t = n - k * 8
    If t > 8 Then t = 8
    If t < 0 Then t = 0
    Tiles.Put 37 - k, 1, GfxData.T_BARR + t
  Next
  For k = 0 To 1
    Tiles.Put 2 + k, 2, GfxData.T_ROUND - (wins(0) > k)
    Tiles.Put 37 - k, 2, GfxData.T_ROUND - (wins(1) > k)
  Next
  Clock1
End Sub

Sub Clock1()
  Tiles.Text 19, 1, Format$(clock, "00")
End Sub

Sub BigText(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String, ByVal colour As Integer)
  Dim n As Integer, r As Integer, b As Integer, bits As Integer, ch As String
  For n = 1 To Len(s)
    ch = Mid$(s, n, 1)
    For r = 0 To 4
      bits = Glyph(ch, r)
      For b = 0 To 2
        If bits And (4 \ (2 ^ b)) Then Tiles.Put x + b, y + r, GfxData.T_LOGO + colour
      Next
    Next
    x = x + 4
  Next
End Sub

Function Glyph(ByVal ch As String, ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
  Dim p As String
  Select Case ch
    Case "K": p = "55655"
    Case "O": p = "75557"
    Case "A": p = "25755"
    Case "L": p = "44447"
    Case "E": p = "74647"
    Case "Y": p = "55222"
    Case Else: p = "00000"
  End Select
  Glyph = Val(Mid$(p, r + 1, 1))
End Function

' a message in the middle (cleared with "")
Sub Banner(ByVal s As String)
  Tiles.Rect 10, 9, 20, 1, GfxData.T_DARK
  If s <> "" Then Tiles.Text 20 - Len(s) \ 2, 9, s Else Alley2
End Sub

' the sky row the banner covered, back (one row of the backdrop)
Sub Alley2()
  Dim x As Integer
  For x = 10 To 29
    Tiles.Put x, 9, Tiles.Get(x, 10)
  Next
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the title
Sub Title()
  Dim k As Integer
  Spr.HideRange 0, 16
  Spr.Show
  Nx.Seed 1234
  Alley
  Tiles.Rect 6, 14, 10, 4, GfxData.T_BRICK          ' no sign on the title
  BigText 9, 5, "KO", 0
  BigText 19, 5, "ALLEY", 1
  Tiles.Rect 10, 12, 20, 5, GfxData.T_DARK
  Tiles.Text 11, 13, "1  ONE PLAYER V CPU"
  Tiles.Text 11, 15, "2  TWO PLAYERS"
  Tiles.Text 1, 28, "P1  Q A O P  SPACE PUNCH  M KICK  N ORB"
  Tiles.Text 1, 29, "P2  7 6 5 8  0 PUNCH  9 KICK  4 ORB"
  Tiles.Text 1, 30, "HOLD AWAY TO BLOCK  KEMPSTON 1 AND 2"
  ' the two fighters face off
  fx(0) = 44 : fy(0) = FLOOR : face(0) = 1 : fs(0) = S_IDLE : flash(0) = 0
  fx(1) = 276 : fy(1) = FLOOR : face(1) = -1 : fs(1) = S_IDLE : flash(1) = 0
  players = 0 : frames = 0
  Do
    Frame
    Spr.Show
    Sfx.Update
    frames = frames + 1 : seed = seed + 1
    anim(0) = frames : anim(1) = frames + 7
    DrawFighter 0
    DrawFighter 1
    If Keys.Down(Keys.Key1) Then players = 1
    If Keys.Down(Keys.Key2) Then players = 2
    If FirePressed() Then players = 1
  Loop Until players > 0
  Nx.Seed seed
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- a match: best of three
Sub Match()
  wins(0) = 0 : wins(1) = 0 : rnum = 1
  Do
    PlayRound
    rnum = rnum + 1
  Loop Until wins(0) = 2 Or wins(1) = 2
  If wins(0) = 2 Then Banner "JAX WINS THE MATCH" Else Banner "KANE WINS THE MATCH"
  Wait1 200
  Banner ""
End Sub

Sub Wait1(ByVal n As Integer)
  Dim k As Integer
  For k = 1 To n
    Frame
    Spr.Show
    Sfx.Update
    frames = frames + 1
    anim(0) = anim(0) + 1 : anim(1) = anim(1) + 1
    DrawFighter 0
    DrawFighter 1
  Next
End Sub

Sub PlayRound()
  Dim n As Integer, w As Integer
  Alley
  Spr.HideRange 0, 16
  For n = 0 To 1
    fy(n) = FLOOR : fvx(n) = 0 : fvy(n) = 0 : fs(n) = S_IDLE : ft(n) = 0 : hp(n) = 100
    flash(n) = 0 : oon(n) = 0 : push(n) = 0 : wasP(n) = -1 : wasK(n) = -1 : wasS(n) = -1
    Spr.Hide 12 + n
  Next
  fx(0) = 100 : fx(1) = 220 : face(0) = 1 : face(1) = -1
  clock = 99 : tick = 0 : roundOver = 0 : aiT = 0 : sparkT = 0
  HudNames
  Banner "ROUND " & CStr(rnum)
  Wait1 70
  Banner "FIGHT"
  Sfx.Play 2, 80, -2, 15, 25, 0
  Wait1 30
  Banner ""
  Do
    Frame
    Spr.Show
    Sfx.Update
    frames = frames + 1
    ReadPads
    For n = 0 To 1
      Fighter n
    Next
    Separate
    Orbs
    For n = 0 To 1
      anim(n) = anim(n) + 1
      DrawFighter n
    Next
    Sparks
    ' the clock
    tick = tick + 1
    If tick >= 50 And roundOver = 0 Then
      tick = 0
      If clock > 0 Then clock = clock - 1
      Clock1
      If clock = 0 Then roundOver = 1
    End If
    If roundOver Then roundOver = roundOver + 1
  Loop Until roundOver > 90
  ' who won it
  If hp(0) > hp(1) Then
    w = 0
  ElseIf hp(1) > hp(0) Then
    w = 1
  Else
    w = Rnd(2)
  End If
  wins(w) = wins(w) + 1
  If hp(w) > 0 Then fs(w) = S_WIN
  Hud
  If w = 0 Then Banner "JAX WINS" Else Banner "KANE WINS"
  Sfx.Play 0, 100, -3, 14, 40, 0
  Wait1 120
  Banner ""
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- a fighter's frame
Sub Fighter(ByVal n As Integer)
  Dim o As Integer, fwd As Integer, back As Integer, pP As Integer, pK As Integer, pS As Integer
  o = 1 - n
  ' the buttons pressed this frame, not held
  pP = bP(n) And Not wasP(n) : wasP(n) = bP(n)
  pK = bK(n) And Not wasK(n) : wasK(n) = bK(n)
  pS = bS(n) And Not wasS(n) : wasS(n) = bS(n)
  If face(n) > 0 Then
    fwd = bR(n) : back = bL(n)
  Else
    fwd = bL(n) : back = bR(n)
  End If
  If flash(n) > 0 Then flash(n) = flash(n) - 1
  If push(n) <> 0 Then
    fx(n) = fx(n) + push(n)
    If push(n) > 0 Then push(n) = push(n) - 1 Else push(n) = push(n) + 1
  End If
  If roundOver And fs(n) <> S_DOWN And fs(n) <> S_JUMP Then
    fs(n) = S_IDLE
    Exit Sub
  End If
  Select Case fs(n)
    Case S_IDLE, S_WALK, S_CROUCH
      ' turn to face the other one
      If fx(o) > fx(n) Then face(n) = 1 Else face(n) = -1
      If pS And oon(n) = 0 Then
        StartAttack n, A_ORB
      ElseIf pP Then
        StartAttack n, A_PUNCH
      ElseIf pK And bD(n) Then
        StartAttack n, A_LOW
      ElseIf pK Then
        StartAttack n, A_KICK
      ElseIf bU(n) Then
        fs(n) = S_JUMP : fvy(n) = -40 : fvx(n) = 0
        If fwd Then fvx(n) = 3 * face(n)
        If back Then fvx(n) = -3 * face(n)
        Sfx.Play 0, 200, -8, 8, 6, 0
      ElseIf bD(n) Then
        fs(n) = S_CROUCH
      ElseIf fwd Then
        fs(n) = S_WALK : fx(n) = fx(n) + 2 * face(n)
      ElseIf back Then
        fs(n) = S_WALK : fx(n) = fx(n) - 2 * face(n)
      Else
        fs(n) = S_IDLE
      End If
    Case S_JUMP
      fvy(n) = fvy(n) + 3
      fy(n) = fy(n) + fvy(n) \ 4
      fx(n) = fx(n) + fvx(n)
      If (pK Or pP) And fatk(n) = 0 Then
        fatk(n) = A_JKICK : ft(n) = 0 : fhit(n) = 0
        Sfx.Play 0, 150, 10, 10, 6, 0
      End If
      If fatk(n) = A_JKICK Then
        ft(n) = ft(n) + 1
        If ft(n) > 3 And fhit(n) = 0 Then TryHit n
      End If
      If fy(n) >= FLOOR Then
        fy(n) = FLOOR : fs(n) = S_IDLE : fatk(n) = 0 : fvx(n) = 0
      End If
    Case S_ATTACK
      ft(n) = ft(n) + 1
      Attack n
    Case S_BLOCK, S_HIT
      ft(n) = ft(n) - 1
      If ft(n) <= 0 Then fs(n) = S_IDLE
    Case S_DOWN
      ft(n) = ft(n) + 1
  End Select
  If fx(n) < XMIN Then fx(n) = XMIN
  If fx(n) > XMAX Then fx(n) = XMAX
End Sub

Sub StartAttack(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal a As Integer)
  fs(n) = S_ATTACK : fatk(n) = a : ft(n) = 0 : fhit(n) = 0
  Sfx.Play 0, 120 + a * 30, 10, 9, 6, 0
End Sub

' the timing of each attack: startup, active to, recovery to (frames)
Sub Attack(ByVal n As Integer)
  Dim t As Integer
  t = ft(n)
  Select Case fatk(n)
    Case A_PUNCH
      If t >= 4 And t <= 7 And fhit(n) = 0 Then TryHit n
      If t >= 16 Then EndAttack n
    Case A_KICK
      If t >= 6 And t <= 9 And fhit(n) = 0 Then TryHit n
      If t >= 22 Then EndAttack n
    Case A_LOW
      If t >= 5 And t <= 8 And fhit(n) = 0 Then TryHit n
      If t >= 20 Then EndAttack n
    Case A_ORB
      If t = 10 Then
        oon(n) = 1 : ox(n) = fx(n) + 30 * face(n) : oy(n) = fy(n) - 70 : ovx(n) = 4 * face(n)
        Sfx.Play 1, 300, -6, 12, 20, 0
      End If
      If t >= 30 Then EndAttack n
  End Select
End Sub

Sub EndAttack(ByVal n As Integer)
  fs(n) = S_IDLE : fatk(n) = 0
  If bD(n) Then fs(n) = S_CROUCH
End Sub

' does n's attack reach the other one now?
Sub TryHit(ByVal n As Integer)
  Dim o As Integer, reach As Integer, d As Integer, top As Integer, bot As Integer, z As Integer, dmg As Integer
  Dim otop As Integer
  o = 1 - n
  Select Case fatk(n)
    Case A_PUNCH: reach = 50 : top = 80 : bot = 56 : z = Z_MID : dmg = 6
    Case A_KICK: reach = 60 : top = 84 : bot = 60 : z = Z_HIGH : dmg = 10
    Case A_LOW: reach = 58 : top = 20 : bot = 0 : z = Z_LOW : dmg = 8
    Case Else: reach = 50 : top = 50 : bot = 20 : z = Z_OVER : dmg = 10
  End Select
  d = (fx(o) - fx(n)) * face(n)
  If d < 0 Or d > reach + 14 Then Exit Sub
  ' the height the attack covers (pixels above n's feet) against the other one's body
  If fs(o) = S_CROUCH Or (fs(o) = S_BLOCK And bD(o)) Then otop = 56 Else otop = 92
  If fs(o) = S_DOWN Then Exit Sub
  If (fy(n) - bot) < (fy(o) - otop) Then Exit Sub
  If (fy(n) - top) > fy(o) Then Exit Sub
  fhit(n) = 1
  Struck o, z, dmg, fx(n), fy(n) - (top + bot) \ 2
End Sub

' o is struck: blocked, or hurt
Sub Struck(ByVal o As Integer, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal dmg As Integer, ByVal hx As Integer, ByVal hy As Integer)
  Dim away As Integer, crouch As Integer, ok As Integer
  If face(o) > 0 Then away = bL(o) Else away = bR(o)
  crouch = bD(o)
  ok = 0
  If away And (fs(o) = S_IDLE Or fs(o) = S_WALK Or fs(o) = S_CROUCH Or fs(o) = S_BLOCK) Then
    Select Case z
      Case Z_MID: ok = 1
      Case Z_HIGH: ok = 1
      Case Z_LOW: ok = crouch
      Case Else: ok = Not crouch
    End Select
  End If
  sparkX = (hx + fx(o)) \ 2 : sparkY = hy : sparkT = 8
  If ok Then
    fs(o) = S_BLOCK : ft(o) = 10 : push(o) = -3 * face(o)
    hp(o) = hp(o) - 1
    Sfx.Play 1, 20, 0, 9, 5, 1
  Else
    hp(o) = hp(o) - dmg
    flash(o) = 6
    Sfx.Play 1, 8, 2, 15, 12, 1
    If hp(o) <= 0 Then
      hp(o) = 0 : fs(o) = S_DOWN : ft(o) = 0 : push(o) = -8 * face(o)
      If roundOver = 0 Then roundOver = 1
      Banner "K O"
      Sfx.Play 2, 300, 12, 15, 60, 0
    Else
      fs(o) = S_HIT : ft(o) = 16 : push(o) = -5 * face(o)
      If fy(o) < FLOOR Then fs(o) = S_JUMP : fatk(o) = 0
    End If
  End If
  Hud
End Sub

' the two can't stand in each other
Sub Separate()
  Dim d As Integer, m As Integer, l As Integer, r As Integer
  If fy(0) < FLOOR - 40 Or fy(1) < FLOOR - 40 Then Exit Sub
  If fx(0) <= fx(1) Then
    l = 0 : r = 1
  Else
    l = 1 : r = 0
  End If
  d = fx(r) - fx(l)
  If d < 36 Then
    m = (36 - d + 1) \ 2
    fx(l) = fx(l) - m : fx(r) = fx(r) + m
    If fx(l) < XMIN Then
      fx(l) = XMIN : fx(r) = XMIN + 36
    End If
    If fx(r) > XMAX Then
      fx(r) = XMAX : fx(l) = XMAX - 36
    End If
  End If
End Sub

Sub Orbs()
  Dim n As Integer, o As Integer
  For n = 0 To 1
    If oon(n) Then
      o = 1 - n
      ox(n) = ox(n) + ovx(n)
      If ox(n) < 0 Or ox(n) > 320 Then
        oon(n) = 0 : Spr.Hide 12 + n
      ElseIf oon(o) And Abs(ox(n) - ox(o)) < 12 Then
        ' two orbs meet
        oon(n) = 0 : oon(o) = 0 : Spr.Hide 12 : Spr.Hide 13
        sparkX = ox(n) : sparkY = oy(n) : sparkT = 10
        Sfx.Play 1, 5, 1, 15, 15, 1
      ElseIf Abs(ox(n) - fx(o)) < 18 And fs(o) <> S_DOWN And fy(o) > oy(n) + 8 And fy(o) - 92 < oy(n) Then
        oon(n) = 0 : Spr.Hide 12 + n
        If fs(o) = S_CROUCH And oy(n) < fy(o) - 60 Then
          ' ducked under it
        Else
          Struck o, Z_MID, 12, ox(n), oy(n)
        End If
      Else
        Spr.Put 12 + n, ox(n) - 16, oy(n) - 16, GfxData.S_ORB + ((frames \ 3) And 1), Spr.Scale2 + Spr.Pal * (n * 3)
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

Sub Sparks()
  If sparkT > 0 Then
    sparkT = sparkT - 1
    If sparkT = 0 Then
      Spr.Hide 14
    Else
      Spr.Put 14, sparkX - 16, sparkY - 16, GfxData.S_SPARK + ((sparkT \ 2) And 1), Spr.Scale2
    End If
  End If
End Sub

' the six sprites of fighter n, for its state
Sub DrawFighter(ByVal n As Integer)
  Dim p As Integer, x0 As Integer, y0 As Integer, fl As Integer, c As Integer, r As Integer, s As Integer, cx As Integer
  Select Case fs(n)
    Case S_IDLE: p = GfxData.S_IDLE + ((anim(n) \ 16) And 1) * 6
    Case S_WALK: p = GfxData.S_WALK + ((anim(n) \ 8) And 1) * 6
    Case S_CROUCH: p = GfxData.S_CROUCH
    Case S_JUMP
      If fatk(n) = A_JKICK Then p = GfxData.S_KICK Else p = GfxData.S_JUMP
    Case S_ATTACK
      Select Case fatk(n)
        Case A_PUNCH
          If ft(n) < 10 Then p = GfxData.S_PUNCH Else p = GfxData.S_IDLE
        Case A_KICK
          If ft(n) < 14 Then p = GfxData.S_KICK Else p = GfxData.S_IDLE
        Case A_LOW
          If ft(n) < 14 Then p = GfxData.S_LOWKICK Else p = GfxData.S_CROUCH
        Case Else: p = GfxData.S_SPECIAL
      End Select
    Case S_BLOCK: p = GfxData.S_BLOCK
    Case S_HIT: p = GfxData.S_HIT
    Case S_DOWN
      If ft(n) < 12 Then p = GfxData.S_HIT Else p = GfxData.S_DOWN
    Case Else: p = GfxData.S_WIN
  End Select
  fl = Spr.Scale2 + Spr.Pal * n
  If flash(n) > 0 And (flash(n) And 2) Then fl = Spr.Scale2 + Spr.Pal * 2
  If face(n) < 0 Then fl = fl + Spr.MirrorX
  x0 = fx(n) - 32 : y0 = fy(n) - 96
  s = n * 6
  For r = 0 To 2
    For c = 0 To 1
      If face(n) > 0 Then cx = x0 + c * 32 Else cx = x0 + 32 - c * 32
      Spr.Put s, cx, y0 + r * 32, p, fl
      s = s + 1 : p = p + 1
    Next
  Next
End Sub

files.name: Nx.cls
files.text:
' Nx - the ZX Spectrum Next's own hardware, straight on the ports: NextRegs (#243B select,
' #253B value), the layer order, the border, palettes, the CPU speed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' No Z80N opcodes are used (plain out (c)), so any Z80 assembler builds it.
Option Explicit

' layer orders (NextReg #15 bits 4-2): first = on top. S sprites, L Layer 2, U ULA + tilemap
Public Const OrderSLU = 0
Public Const OrderLSU = 1
Public Const OrderSUL = 2
Public Const OrderLUS = 3
Public Const OrderUSL = 4
Public Const OrderULS = 5
' palettes for PalEntry / PalTable (NextReg #43 bits 6-4, the first of each pair)
Public Const PalULA = 0
Public Const PalLayer2 = 1
Public Const PalSprites = 2
Public Const PalTiles = 3

' Reg r, v: NextReg r = v
Public Sub Reg(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
#endasm
End Sub

' RegGet(r): NextReg r read back
Public Function RegGet(ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Layers order: which layer is on top (OrderSLU ...), sprites on and over the border kept
Public Sub Layers(ByVal order As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #15
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            and %11100011
            or e
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Border c: the border colour (0-7, port #FE)
Public Sub Border(ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalEntry which, index, colour: one colour (RRRGGGBB) of a palette (PalULA ... PalTiles, the
' first palette of each)
Public Sub PalEntry(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal index As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a                 ; palette select, bits 6-4
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; index
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; colour
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), l
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalTable which, first, count, address: count colours (1 byte each, RRRGGGBB) from memory
Public Sub PalTable(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer, ByVal address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; count (1-256: 0 = 256)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
pt_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, pt_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Raster(): the line the display is on now (0-311; 0-191 the picture)
Public Function Raster() As Integer
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
rs_again:
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in d, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            cp d
            jr nz, rs_again
            and 1
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

' Seed n: start Rnd's sequence from n (as Randomize n - kept here because Randomize with a
' variable doesn't link on its own in this NTC build: kw_seedv jumps into kw_seedl's section)
Public Sub Seed(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            or h
            jr nz, sd_ok
            inc l
sd_ok:
            ld (ntc_rnd_seed), hl
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Spr.cls
files.text:
' Spr - the Next's 128 hardware sprites, straight on the ports (#303B slot, #57 attributes).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' 4 bit patterns (GfxData.Load puts them in the sprite RAM), 16 x 16 pixels, scaled 1x - 8x.
' Put / Hide write a table in RAM; Show sends the table to the hardware in one go (do it just
' after Frame, so nothing moves half way down the screen).
' Coordinates are the tilemap's: 0, 0 is the top left of the whole 320 x 256 picture (the
' border included); the 256 x 192 paper is 32 - 287 across, 32 - 223 down. A sprite at x -16 .. or
' y -16 .. wraps (512): keep it hidden instead.
Option Explicit

' flags for Put: add them
Public Const MirrorX = 8
Public Const MirrorY = 4
Public Const Rotate = 2
Public Const Scale2X = &H800
Public Const Scale2Y = &H200
Public Const Scale2 = &HA00
Public Const Scale4X = &H1000
Public Const Scale4Y = &H400
Public Const Scale4 = &H1400
' a palette offset: Pal * n (n 0 - 15: spr_pal.png's row n)
Public Const Pal = 16

Private tab(639) As Byte          ' 128 x 5 attribute bytes
Private used As Integer           ' the highest slot Put + 1 (Show sends that many)

' Init: every sprite hidden, sprites on (over the border too), transparent colour 15
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 639
    tab(i) = 0
  Next
  For i = 3 To 639 Step 5
    tab(i) = &H40                ' hidden, but still 5 bytes (the upload stays in step)
  Next
  used = 128
  Show
  used = 0
  Nx.Reg &H4B, &HF               ' 4 bit sprites: colour 15 is transparent
  Nx.Reg &H15, (Nx.RegGet(&H15) And &H1C) Or 3   ' sprites on, over the border; the order kept
End Sub

' Put n, x, y, pattern, flags: sprite n (0-127) at x, y showing pattern (0-127), with flags
' (MirrorX + Scale2 + Pal * 2 ...)
Public Sub Put(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal pattern As Integer, ByVal flags As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld c, a
            inc a
            ld hl, {used}
            cp (hl)
            jr c, sp_low
            ld (hl), a
sp_low:
            ld l, c                 ; DE = tab + n * 5
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab}
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl                  ; x
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 0: x bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld c, a                 ; x bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; y
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 1: y bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld b, a                 ; y bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; pattern
            ld a, (hl)
            ex af, af'
            pop hl                  ; flags
            ld a, (hl)
            and #FE
            or c
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 2: palette offset, mirrors, rotate, x bit 8
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; scale bits
            ex af, af'
            ld l, a
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 3: visible, 5 bytes, pattern bits 6-1
            inc de
            ld a, l
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            or b
            ld b, a
            ld a, c
            and #1E
            or b
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 4: 4 bit, pattern bit 0, scale, y bit 8
#endasm
End Sub

' Hide n: sprite n not shown
Public Sub Hide(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), #40            ; not visible, 5 bytes kept (else the upload slips a byte)
#endasm
End Sub

' HideRange first, count: those sprites not shown
Public Sub HideRange(ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, hr_done
            ld b, a
            ex de, hl
            ld de, 5
hr_lp:
            ld (hl), #40
            add hl, de
            djnz hr_lp
hr_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the table to the hardware (the slots up to the highest one Put)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld a, ({used})
            or a
            jr z, sh_done
            ld bc, #303B
            xor a
            out (c), a
            ld a, ({used})
            ld e, a                 ; E sprites, 5 bytes each
            ld hl, {tab}
            ld c, #57
sh_lp:
            ld b, 5
            otir
            dec e
            jr nz, sh_lp
sh_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Visible(n): True when sprite n is shown
Public Function Visible(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld de, 0
            and #80
            jr z, vi_no
            dec de
vi_no:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

files.name: Tiles.cls
files.text:
' Tiles - the Next's tilemap as a 4 bit picture: 40 x 32 cells of 8 x 8 pixels over the whole
' 320 x 256 display (the border included), 16 colours (tile_pal.png), colour 15 transparent.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' The map stays where the platform put it (bank 5 + #2000, seen at #E000: one byte a cell, the
' tile number), so Print and Locate still work on it: the font is tiles 32-126 (a character's code
' is its tile). The tile definitions go to bank 5 + #0000 (#C000-#DFFF, 32 bytes a tile): the
' ULA screen's place, so the ULA is turned off. Don't use Mode or Cls after Init (Mode puts the
' platform's own text tiles back; Cls is all right but fills with tile 32).
' Print near the right edge or the last row wraps and scrolls: end prints with ; and keep them
' off row 32 and column 40.
Option Explicit

Public Const Cols = 40
Public Const Rows = 32
Private Const MAPA = &HE000

' Init: the tilemap on, 40 x 32, 4 bit tiles from #C000, no attribute bytes, over the ULA;
' the ULA off; no scroll; the whole picture
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H68, Nx.RegGet(&H68) Or &H80     ' the ULA off (its screen's RAM holds the tiles)
  Nx.Reg &H6E, &H20                         ' the map: bank 5 + #2000
  Nx.Reg &H6F, &H0                          ' the tile definitions: bank 5 + #0000
  Nx.Reg &H6C, 0                            ' every cell: palette offset 0, no mirror
  Nx.Reg &H4C, &HF                          ' colour 15 transparent
  Nx.Reg &H2F, 0 : Nx.Reg &H30, 0 : Nx.Reg &H31, 0
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 8                            ' the clip window: all of it
  Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 159 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 255
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &HA1                         ' on, 40 x 32, no attributes, 4 bit, over the ULA
End Sub

' Put x, y, t: cell x (0-39), y (0-31) shows tile t
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)              ; y
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; y * 40
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Get(x, y): the tile in cell x, y
Public Function Get(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ld e, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' At(px, py): the tile under pixel px, py (0-319, 0-255), 0 off the map
Public Function At(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; px
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; py
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, at_off
            ld a, d
            cp 2
            jr nc, at_off
            ld hl, -320
            add hl, de
            jr c, at_off
            srl d                   ; px / 8
            rr e
            srl e
            srl e
            ld a, c
            and #F8                 ; (py / 8) * 8
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, bc              ; (py / 8) * 40
            ld d, #E0
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            jr at_set
at_off:
            ld e, 0
at_set:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fill t: every cell tile t
Public Sub Fill(ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 40 * 32 - 1
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t: a block of cells
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Text x, y, s: text from cell x, y (the font tiles), no wrap, no scroll
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
tx_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, tx_done
            ld (de), a
            inc hl
            inc de
            ld a, d
            cp #E5                  ; past the map's end (#E500)
            jr nc, tx_done
            jr tx_lp
tx_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Scroll x, y: the tilemap moved by x (0-319) and y (0-255) pixels
Public Sub Scroll(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H2F, (x \ 256) And 3
  Nx.Reg &H30, x And 255
  Nx.Reg &H31, y And 255
End Sub

files.name: Sfx.cls
files.text:
' Sfx - sound effects on the Next's AY chip (the first of its three), straight on the ports:
' #FFFD picks a register, #BFFD writes it. Three channels, each playing one effect at a time:
' a tone or noise whose pitch slides and whose volume fades to nothing over its length.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' Call Update once a frame (50 a second).
'   Sfx.Play 0, 200, 8, 15, 12, 0     ' channel A: tone period 200, rising pitch... 12 frames
Option Explicit

Private per(2) As Integer         ' the tone period now (12 bits; noise: 0-31)
Private slide(2) As Integer       ' added to it each frame
Private vol(2) As Integer         ' the volume it starts at (0-15)
Private total(2) As Integer       ' its length in frames
Private left(2) As Integer        ' frames to go (0 = silent)
Private nse(2) As Integer         ' 1 = noise, 0 = tone
Private mix As Integer

Private Sub W(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #FFFD
            out (c), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld b, #BF
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Init: AY 1 picked (the Next has three: Turbosound), every channel quiet
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  Out &HFFFD, &HFF                 ' AY 1 (Turbosound: #FF, #FE, #FD pick the chips)
  For i = 0 To 13
    W i, 0
  Next
  W 7, &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
  Next
End Sub

' Play ch, period, slidePerFrame, volume, frames, noise: start an effect on channel ch (0-2)
Public Sub Play(ByVal ch As Integer, ByVal period As Integer, ByVal sl As Integer, ByVal volume As Integer, ByVal frames As Integer, ByVal noise As Integer)
  If ch < 0 Or ch > 2 Then Exit Sub
  per(ch) = period : slide(ch) = sl : vol(ch) = volume : total(ch) = frames : left(ch) = frames : nse(ch) = noise
End Sub

' Busy(ch): True while channel ch plays
Public Function Busy(ByVal ch As Integer) As Integer
  Busy = (left(ch) > 0)
End Function

' Update: once a frame - the pitches slide, the volumes fade, the AY written
Public Sub Update()
  Dim i As Integer, v As Integer, p As Integer
  mix = &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    If left(i) > 0 Then
      v = (vol(i) * left(i) + total(i) - 1) \ total(i)
      p = per(i)
      If nse(i) Then
        W 6, p And 31
        mix = mix And Not (8 * (2 ^ i))
      Else
        W i * 2, p And 255
        W i * 2 + 1, (p \ 256) And 15
        mix = mix And Not (2 ^ i)
      End If
      W 8 + i, v
      per(i) = per(i) + slide(i)
      If per(i) < 1 Then per(i) = 1
      left(i) = left(i) - 1
    Else
      W 8 + i, 0
    End If
  Next
  W 7, mix
End Sub

' Quiet: every channel stopped
Public Sub Quiet()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
    W 8 + i, 0
  Next
End Sub
